title: Field compute workbench
noSession: No active session; select a session first
noUploads: No uploaded data in this session yet
unitRequired: Units must be declared explicitly: field names are hints only; declare canonical units in field_units below
examplesTitle: Editable examples (click to fill; field names are placeholders - replace with your columns)
exDensityDesc: Population divided by area, derives a density dimension
exRateDesc: Zero base returns null via a lazy if, avoiding divide-by-zero
exClassDesc: Classify by threshold with if branches
expressionPlaceholder: e.g. population divided by area (wrap field names in braces)
expressionHint: Wrap a field name in braces to reference CJK or spaced names; click a field above to insert
fieldUnitsHint: Use canonical unit names (persons / square_kilometers / percent ...); only explicit declarations count, field-name guesses are ignored
projectId: Project ID (optional, saves as project artifact)
projectIdPlaceholder: Leave empty for a session-only ref
staleHint: Params changed - previous preview is stale, preview again
confirmationNote: Execute binds this preview's params fingerprint (expected_fingerprint)
sampleOnlyNote: All figures below are sample-based, not full-data results
sampleErrorRateNote: Sample estimate only, not the full-data error rate
persistenceSession: Session-only ref (session_ref), NOT permanently saved; may expire with the session
multiColumnNote: This panel edits one column at a time; for chained multi-column derivations (e.g. density then class) use the Pi conversation or the API (up to 8 columns, declaration order is execution order).
cancelRequested: Server-side cancellation requested; if the task already reached the write phase, a result may still be produced and can be looked up in the result table.
loadIncomplete: Load failed: result is empty or invalid; placeholder layer removed (result ref is still kept)
projectSaveFailed: Project manifest save failed: result is session-scoped only and may not survive a restart (PROJECT_SAVE_FAILED)
cancelNoActive: No active execution for this plan, so no server-side cancel was registered; if you just stopped waiting, the run may already have finished — check the result table.
cancelLocalOnly: Stopped waiting locally; server-side cancellation could not be confirmed, so a result may still exist — check the result table.
